title: presidio-hardened/training-run@1
description: Key-less Layer-0 training-run reading emitted by presidio-hardened-arch-translucency (build_training_run_reading, its ADR-0009) and signed into an evidence-ref envelope by a sidecar. Registered after the fact (ADR-0006) from the shipped producer and the vectors under vectors/training-run/; it describes what is already on the wire and changes none of it. 'attested_content' is the hashed and signed payload: content_hash = sha256(canonical-json@1(attested_content)). Frozen under ADR-0001 D5. Integer fields are JSON integers (canonical-json@1 rejects floats). energy_wh / mean_power_w are GRANDFATHERED by ADR-0005: they keep the shortest-round-trip IEEE-754 decimal string the producer shipped in v0.23 (repr(float), e.g. '840.0' or '1e-05'), not the ADR-0005 plain-notation profile; the round-trip property itself is producer-enforced and not expressible here. 'parents' follows ADR-0002 P1-P5; a parent that refers to a gate decision is that gate-certificate@1's identity (ADR-0006). No additionalProperties:false, matching the family posture (ADR-0003 extra-field finding).

ieeeRoundTripDecimal.description: Grandfathered (ADR-0005): Python repr of a finite, non-negative float. Either plain with at least one fractional digit, or exponent form.
